Redesign the Profile page at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/pages/Profile.tsx` following the shadcnblocks "Settings Profile 2" pattern — sectioned form with avatar, personal info, work details, social links, separated by dividers.

Read CLAUDE.md first. Then read: `src/pages/Profile.tsx` (current), `src/pages/Settings.tsx` (for patterns), `src/hooks/useAuth.tsx` (auth context), `src/hooks/useTeam.tsx`.

## Current state
- Read-only profile display: avatar initials, name (derived from email), email, plan badge, credits
- ChangePasswordCard component
- Usage stats (jobs, resumes, credits used)
- No editable fields, no avatar upload, no social links, no bio

## What to build — complete rewrite of Profile.tsx

### DB Migration — `supabase/migrations/20260410200000_profile_fields.sql`

```sql
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS full_name text;
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS username text;
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS bio text;
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS avatar_url text;
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS job_title text;

ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS location text;
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS website text;
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS twitter text;
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS linkedin text;
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS github text;
```

### Page Structure (shadcnblocks pattern)

```

│ Profile                                          │
│ Manage your personal information and preferences │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                  │
│ [Avatar Circle]  Upload / Remove                 │

│ ──────────── Personal Information ────────────── │
│                                                  │
│ Full Name        │  Username (@handle)           │
│ [____________]   │  [@ ____________]             │
│                                                  │
│ Email (read-only)│  Member Since                 │
│ [____________]   │  January 2026                 │
│                                                  │
│ Bio                                              │

│                                                  │
│ Website          │  Twitter                      │
│ [https:// ____]  │  [twitter.com/ ____]          │
│                                                  │
│ LinkedIn         │  GitHub                       │
│ [linkedin.com/]  │  [github.com/ ____]           │
│                                                  │
│ ──────────── Plan & Usage ───────────────────── │
│                                                  │
│ [Plan Badge]  [Credits Badge]  [Subscription]    │
│                                                  │
│ ┌──────┐  ┌──────┐  ┌──────┐                   │
│ │  12  │  │  156 │  │  892 │                    │
│ │ Jobs │  │Resum.│  │Creds │                    │
│ └──────┘  └──────┘  └──────┘                    │
│                                                  │
│              [Cancel]  [Save Changes]            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Implementation details

**Avatar section:**
- Large circle (h-20 w-20) with initials fallback or avatar_url image
- "Upload photo" button (uploads to Supabase Storage `avatars` bucket, saves URL to profiles.avatar_url)
- "Remove" button (deletes from storage, nulls avatar_url)
- Use a hidden file input triggered by the button

**Personal Information section:**
- Full Name: Input, editable
- Username: Input with "@" prefix addon (like shadcnblocks), editable
- Email: Input, disabled/read-only (comes from auth, can't change here)
- Member Since: displayed as text, not editable
- Bio: Textarea, max 160 chars with character counter

**Work Details section:**
- Job Title: Input
- Company: Input
- Location: Input

**Social Links section:**
- Website: Input with "https://" prefix
- Twitter: Input with "twitter.com/" prefix
- LinkedIn: Input with "linkedin.com/in/" prefix
- GitHub: Input with "github.com/" prefix

Each prefix should be a gray addon on the left of the input (same pattern as shadcnblocks).

**Plan & Usage section:**
- Plan badge + credits badge + subscription status (same as current but in a row)
- 3 stat cards (jobs, resumes, credits used) from existing stats query

**Action buttons:**
- "Cancel" (outline) — resets form to saved values
- "Save Changes" (primary) — saves all editable fields to profiles table

**Section headers:**
Each section separated by: `<Separator className="my-6" />` with a small uppercase label above.

### Form state management
```typescript
const [form, setForm] = useState({
  full_name: "", username: "", bio: "", avatar_url: "",
  job_title: "", company: "", location: "",
  website: "", twitter: "", linkedin: "", github: "",
});

// Load from profile on mount
useEffect(() => {
  if (profile) {
    setForm({
      full_name: (profile as any).full_name ?? "",
      username: (profile as any).username ?? "",
      // ... etc
    });
  }
}, [profile]);

// Save
const handleSave = async () => {
  await (supabase as any).from("profiles").update(form).eq("user_id", user.id);
  await refreshProfile();
  toast.success("Profile updated");
};
```

### Keep existing functionality
- Usage stats query (React Query)
- ChangePasswordCard component — render it AFTER the main profile card as a separate section
- Plan/credits display

### Remove
- The old read-only Card layout — replaced entirely by the new editable form

## Constraints
- NEVER edit `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts`
- `(supabase as any)` for new profile columns
- `@/` imports, shadcn-ui only, Sonner toasts
- SidebarLayout wrapper, `w-full px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 py-8`
- Input prefix addons: use a wrapper div with the prefix as a span
- Run `npm run build` — zero errors

content.text:
Here is the complete plan:

---

## Plan: Profile Page Redesign

### Files to create/modify

**1. `supabase/migrations/20260410200000_profile_fields.sql`** (new file)

11 `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` statements on `public.profiles`:
- `full_name`, `username`, `bio`, `avatar_url` (personal)
- `job_title`, `company`, `location` (work)
- `website`, `twitter`, `linkedin`, `github` (social)

All `text` type, all nullable.

**2. `src/pages/Profile.tsx`** (full rewrite)

---

### Architecture decisions

**Data loading strategy (key decision):**
The `useAuth` profile context only fetches a fixed set of columns and I must not modify `types.ts`. So instead of touching useAuth, the page will run its own dedicated React Query (`queryKey: ["profileFull", user?.id]`) that fetches the new columns via `(supabase as any)`. The form populates from that query. After save, `queryClient.invalidateQueries(["profileFull"])` + `refreshProfile()` to sync credits.

**Input prefix addon pattern:**
A raw `<input>` nested inside a styled wrapper div (not shadcn `<Input>`) to achieve the "twitter.com/ [handle]" visual grouping without fighting shadcn's border/ring on a sibling element. The wrapper div carries the border and focus ring.

---

### Page sections (top to bottom inside main Card)

| # | Section | Components |
|---|---------|-----------|
| 1 | Avatar | Circle (img or initials), Upload button, Remove button, hidden file input |
| 2 | Personal Information | Separator + label, 2-col grid: Full Name, Username (@prefix), Email (disabled), Member Since (static text), Bio (full-width Textarea, 160-char counter) |
| 3 | Work Details | Separator + label, 2-col grid: Job Title, Company, Location (full width) |
| 4 | Social Links | Separator + label, 2-col grid: Website (https://), Twitter (twitter.com/), LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/), GitHub (github.com/) |
| 5 | Plan & Usage | Separator + label, badge row (plan + credits + subscription), 3 stat cards (jobs/resumes/credits used) with Skeleton while loading |
| 6 | Action buttons | Cancel (outline, resets form) + Save Changes (primary, disabled+spinner while saving) |

Below the card: `<ChangePasswordCard />` unchanged.

---

### Avatar upload flow
1. Hidden `<input type="file" accept="image/*" ref={fileInputRef}>`
2. Upload button calls `fileInputRef.current?.click()`
3. `onChange` handler: upload file to Supabase Storage bucket `avatars` at `{user.id}/{filename}`, get public URL, update `form.avatar_url` and immediately save to DB, call `toast.success`
4. Remove button: deletes from storage (best-effort), sets `form.avatar_url = ""`, saves null to DB

---

### handleSave / handleCancel
- Save: `(supabase as any).from("profiles").update({ ...form }).eq("user_id", user.id)`, then `queryClient.invalidateQueries(["profileFull"])` + `refreshProfile()`, then `toast.success("Profile updated")`
- Cancel: reset form state to `fullProfile` values (same as the `useEffect` on load)

---

### Risk mitigations
- **Storage bucket may not exist:** wrapped in try-catch, descriptive toast error
- **New columns not in types.ts:** all accesses use `(supabase as any)` — zero type conflicts
- **useAuth not touched:** separate React Query for new columns; useAuth only called for `user`, `profile` (credits/plan), `refreshProfile`

---

### Build order
1. Write migration SQL file
2. Write new Profile.tsx
3. `npm run build` — zero errors
4. Confirm `types.ts` is untouched

Ready to execute on your go.
